name: bob_klein_hilo_floating_bridge_reply
description: Email reply from Bob Klein (Aikido of Hilo) to the Ikeda outreach (issue #64), received 2026-09-25. Reports: Ikeda has taught seminars at a Ka'u-district dojo on the Big Island of Hawaii that has operated under two names — Ka'u Aikikai and Floating Bridge Aikido — in 2024, 2025, and 2026, and is slated to return in January 2027. Flyers for the first two years (2024, 2025) were attached to the email (attachments not yet in the reference corpus). Supplied contact: Gary Reiss, greissoffice@gmail.com. Klein's sender address (aikidoofhilo@gmail.com) matches the contact email already on dojo:aikido-of-hilo — Hilo is on the east side of the island, consistent with his 'other side of our Big Island' phrasing for Ka'u.

metadata.claim_text: Bob Klein (Aikido of Hilo) reports that Hiroshi Ikeda 'has taught seminars at another dojo on the other side of our Big Island of Hawaii. The dojo has operated under two names — Ka'u Aikikai and Floating Bridge Aikido. He has taught here 2024, 2025, 2026 and is slated to do so again in January 2027.' Flyers for 2024 and 2025 were attached to the email (not yet in the reference corpus). Klein's phrasing 'taught here' may indicate personal involvement at the host dojo or loose usage — worth confirming with Gary Reiss.
